aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into high-scoring setups and uses leveraged ETFs, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware of significant volatility, potential for rapid losses, and daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes steady monthly distributions from income/covered-call ETFs and broad index exposure, with minimal high-beta single names. While aiming for low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
